units.source_text: 这是一幅严寒的夜景，仿佛可以听到整个冰封雪冻的地壳深处响起冰裂声。

en.t: It was a bitterly cold night scene, as if one could hear ice cracking deep within the frozen crust of the earth.

units.source_text: 抬头仰望，满天星斗，多得令人难以置信。

en.t: Looking up, the sky was filled with an unbelievable number of stars.

units.source_text: 星辰闪闪竞耀，好像以虚幻的速度慢慢坠落下来似的。

en.t: The stars glittered as if vying with one another, seeming to fall slowly at an unreal speed.

units.source_text: 繁星移近眼前，把夜空越推越远，夜色也越来越深沉了。

en.t: The countless stars seemed to move closer, pushing the night sky farther and farther away, while the darkness grew deeper.

units.source_text: 县界的山峦已经层次不清，显得更加黑苍苍的，沉重地垂在星空的边际。

en.t: The mountains along the prefectural border had lost their layered outlines and looked even darker, hanging heavily at the edge of the starry sky.

units.source_text: 这是一片清寒、静谧的和谐气氛。

en.t: It was an atmosphere of clear cold, silence, and harmony.
